summary.text: OSTP's page states that its director oversees the development and execution of the nation's science and technology policy agenda, including critical and emerging technologies. In February 2025, OSTP invited public input on actions to include in the AI Action Plan. OSTP posts from 2023 and 2024 described managing AI risks while seizing its benefits and advancing safe, secure, and trustworthy AI. Later OSTP posts in 2025 and 2026 highlighted AI leadership, innovation, education, infrastructure, and exports.
